articles.title: A Homegrown Food & Drink Guide To Durga Pujo In Kolkata
articles.summary: Durga Pujo in Kolkata is a vibrant celebration of culture, community, and cuisine. The city transforms into a gastronomic paradise, offering everything from traditional Bengali dishes at pice hotels to modern Pan-Asian delights. Iconic spots like Arsalan for Kolkata Biryani and Amar Khamar’s home-style meals showcase the city’s culinary diversity, making Pujo a feast for the senses.
